children: a $0.20 per-share Q3 2026 common dividend, payable around October 13 to shareholders of record September 30.
The company also declared a $0.46875 per-share dividend on its 7.50% Series E preferred stock, payable October 15 to holders of record September 30.
The Board reauthorized $50M of share-repurchase capacity through December 31, 2026.
From July 1 through September 9, FBRT repurchased 6.12M common shares at an average net price of $8.23 per share.
The Q3 Series H preferred dividend will equal the as-converted common dividend amount.
